* Summary [#summary]
`JTable`のセル幅に合わせて文字列を折り返します。

#en{{
This code wraps text to fit the cell width of the `JTable`.
}}

#download(https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/_9Z4BYR88imo/TQTUbGVPssI/AAAAAAAAAmA/dPiTKpwf1Ro/s800/TableCellRenderer.png)

* Source Code Examples [#sourcecode]
#code(link){{
getColumnModel().getColumn(0).setCellRenderer(new DefaultTableCellRenderer());
getColumnModel().getColumn(1).setCellRenderer(new WrappedLabelRenderer());
getColumnModel().getColumn(2).setCellRenderer(new TextAreaCellRenderer());
// ...
class WrappedLabelRenderer implements TableCellRenderer {
  private final JLabel renderer = new WrappedLabel() {
    @Override public void updateUI() {
      super.updateUI();
      setOpaque(true);
      setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(0, 5, 0, 5));
    }
  };

  @Override public Component getTableCellRendererComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, boolean hasFocus, int row, int column) {
    if (isSelected) {
      renderer.setForeground(table.getSelectionForeground());
      renderer.setBackground(table.getSelectionBackground());
    } else {
      renderer.setForeground(table.getForeground());
      renderer.setBackground(table.getBackground());
    }
    boolean isNumber = value instanceof Number;
    renderer.setHorizontalAlignment(isNumber ? SwingConstants.RIGHT : SwingConstants.LEFT);
    renderer.setFont(table.getFont());
    renderer.setText(Objects.toString(value, ""));
    return renderer;
  }
}

class WrappedLabel extends JLabel {
  private transient GlyphVector gvText;

  // ...

  @Override public void doLayout() {
    Rectangle r = SwingUtilities.calculateInnerArea(this, null);
    Font font = getFont();
    FontMetrics fm = getFontMetrics(font);
    FontRenderContext frc = fm.getFontRenderContext();
    GlyphVector gv = font.createGlyphVector(frc, getText());
    gvText = getWrappedGlyphVector(gv, r.getWidth());
    super.doLayout();
  }

  @Override protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
    if (Objects.nonNull(gvText)) {
      Insets i = getInsets();
      Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
      g2.setPaint(getBackground());
      g2.fillRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());
      g2.setPaint(getForeground());
      g2.drawGlyphVector(gvText, i.left, getFont().getSize2D() + i.top);
      g2.dispose();
    } else {
      super.paintComponent(g);
    }
  }

  private static GlyphVector getWrappedGlyphVector(GlyphVector gv, double width) {
    Point2D gmPos = new Point2D.Float();
    float lineHeight = (float) gv.getLogicalBounds().getHeight();
    float pos = 0f;
    int lineCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < gv.getNumGlyphs(); i++) {
      GlyphMetrics gm = gv.getGlyphMetrics(i);
      float advance = gm.getAdvance();
      // Wrap only if the line is not empty, so that a glyph wider than
      // the cell does not leave a blank line above it
      if (pos > 0f && pos + advance > width) {
        lineCount++;
        pos = 0f;
      }
      gmPos.setLocation(pos, lineHeight * lineCount);
      gv.setGlyphPosition(i, gmPos);
      pos += advance;
    }
    return gv;
  }
}

// delegation pattern
class TextAreaCellRenderer implements TableCellRenderer {
  private final JTextArea renderer = new JTextArea();

  protected TextAreaCellRenderer() {
    renderer.setLineWrap(true);
    renderer.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(0, 5, 0, 5));
  }

  @Override public Component getTableCellRendererComponent(JTable table, Object value, boolean isSelected, boolean hasFocus, int row, int column) {
    if (isSelected) {
      renderer.setForeground(table.getSelectionForeground());
      renderer.setBackground(table.getSelectionBackground());
    } else {
      renderer.setForeground(table.getForeground());
      renderer.setBackground(table.getBackground());
    }
    renderer.setFont(table.getFont());
    renderer.setText(Objects.toString(value, ""));
    return renderer;
  }
}
}}

* Description [#description]
- `0`列目
-- デフォルトの`JLabel`を継承する`DefaultTableCellRenderer`を使用し超過分は`...`で省略
- `1`列目
-- [[文字列の折り返し>Swing/GlyphVector]]で作成した`JLabel`を継承する`WrappedLabel`をセル描画コンポーネントとして保持するレンダラーを使ってセル幅に合わせて折り返し
-- `CellRendererPane`でセル描画コンポーネントのサイズが変更される、または文字列が変更されると`WrappedLabel#doLayout()`が実行されるので、ここでセルの内部領域の幅に合わせて`GlyphVector`の各グリフの位置を更新する
-- 行が空でなく次のグリフがセル幅を超える場合のみ改行するので、セル幅より広いグリフがあってもその前に空行は挿入されない
- `2`列目
-- `JTextArea`をセル描画コンポーネントとして保持する`TableCellRenderer`を作成し`JTextArea#setLineWrap(boolean)`メソッドを使用して折り返しを有効化
- どちらのレンダラーも行の高さは自動調整しないため、`JTable#setRowHeight(50)`で固定の高さを設定している

#en{{
- Column `0`
    - Uses `DefaultTableCellRenderer`, which extends the default `JLabel`, and truncates overflowing text with `...`
- Column `1`
    - Uses a renderer that holds a `WrappedLabel`, a `JLabel` subclass created in [[Wrap the string in a JLabel>Swing/GlyphVector]], as the cell rendering component to wrap text to fit the cell width
    - `WrappedLabel#doLayout()` is invoked when the `CellRendererPane` changes the size of the cell rendering component or when its text changes, so the position of each glyph in the `GlyphVector` is updated there to fit the width of the inner area of the cell
    - A line is wrapped only when it is not empty and the next glyph would exceed the cell width, so no blank line is inserted before a glyph wider than the cell
- Column `2`
    - Creates a `TableCellRenderer` that holds a `JTextArea` as the cell rendering component, and enables line wrapping with the `JTextArea#setLineWrap(boolean)` method
- Neither renderer adjusts the row height automatically, so a fixed height is set with `JTable#setRowHeight(50)`
}}
